organization_context.name: Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Network
organization_context.context_scope: Public-source alignment assessment for research discussion only; this profile does not represent review, sponsorship, endorsement, or affiliation by the Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Network.

alignment_observations.statement: The network frames grand scientific challenges on a 10- to 15-year horizon to decrease the burden of human disease.
Biohub San Francisco emphasizes dynamic cell systems across scales in health and disease.
Biohub Chicago emphasizes molecular measurement of inflammatory states in human tissues.
Biohub New York emphasizes harnessing and engineering immune cells for early detection, prevention, and treatment research.
The public GREmLN description places AI biomodels and an open virtual-cell platform upstream of disease-mechanism and target discovery.
The public New York FAQ lists Advanced Single Cell Technologies, In Vivo/In Vitro Modeling, Immune Cell Engineering, and Network Causality, AI, and ML as core platforms.
Biohub and CZI public materials describe open-source scientific software as infrastructure for reusable biomedical research.

positioning.one_line: A provenance-preserving translational decision layer that turns upstream biological hypotheses into inspectable evidence packets, explicit gaps, and bounded next actions without replacing the upstream biomodel or making clinical decisions.
upstream_inputs: cell-state or perturbation hypotheses with source and context metadata
outputs: fail-closed advance, hold, defer, pivot, or stop records
source-preserving multi-trial endpoint and safety synthesis
typed evidence gaps and bounded evidence-acquisition actions
preregistered aggregate evaluation and uncertainty reports

maturity_ledger.label: Evidence-governed execution and replay
maturity_ledger.claim: The public core records typed tool requests, outcomes, promoted evidence, accepted decisions, costs, and replay links with fail-closed validation.
limitations: Provider payloads and real review jobs are outside the public repository.
A valid replay demonstrates contract execution, not biological correctness.

maturity_ledger.label: Audited eight-stage SCD vertical slice
maturity_ledger.claim: One retrospective sickle-cell disease slice traverses the eight-stage control plane with typed identity continuity and exact accepted-state replay.
limitations: This is one disease slice and does not establish breadth across the proposed atlases.
It is retrospective and is not a prospective therapeutic recommendation.

maturity_ledger.label: Source-preserving cross-trial endpoint and safety synthesis
maturity_ledger.claim: The implementation recompiles reviewer-approved endpoint and safety selections across source-disjoint trials while retaining trial-level values, provenance, and fixed favorable-direction semantics for hazard, odds, and risk ratios.
limitations: It does not infer endpoint similarity, pool effects, or decide clinical acceptability.
Real reviewer mappings and source bundles remain external.

maturity_ledger.label: Typed evidence gaps and bounded next-action planning
maturity_ledger.claim: The clinical decision layer compiles exact evidence cells into typed gaps and budget-bounded evidence-acquisition actions under a preregistered policy.
limitations: The VOI score is a bounded workflow heuristic, not calibrated economic value of information.
ADVANCE denotes evidence-workflow readiness, not therapeutic approval.

maturity_ledger.label: Preregistered aggregate clinical outcome evaluation
maturity_ledger.claim: The public implementation binds forecasts to exact evidence packages before a deadline and evaluates later endpoint and safety outcomes in aggregate with explicit attrition and provenance controls.
limitations: The public artifacts do not contain a real independently curated outcome board.
Synthetic validation does not establish clinical utility or policy superiority.

maturity_ledger.label: Cluster-superpopulation uncertainty calibration
maturity_ledger.claim: A public known-truth study separates fixed-profile and empirical-template cluster-superpopulation variance while preserving unit-weighted and cluster-balanced estimands.
limitations: Finite public template support is synthetic and is not externally transportable.
Dominant-profile unit-weighted methods retain undercoverage and finite-cluster bias.

maturity_ledger.label: Cell-state and perturbation evidence handoff
maturity_ledger.claim: A strict generic handoff binds cell-state, perturbation, assay, endpoint, uncertainty, sampling, quality-control, lineage, and review context into contextual-only evidence drafts.
limitations: The public fixture is fully synthetic and source truth remains externally reviewed.
No Biohub dataset, model output, experimental workflow, or scientific gate has been integrated.

maturity_ledger.label: Cross-disease clinical contract conformance
maturity_ledger.claim: A synthetic ulcerative-colitis slice exercises contextual translational handoff, clinical-remission endpoint mapping, higher-is-better odds-ratio synthesis, and provenance-preserving evidence-tensor compilation under one MONDO disease identity.
limitations: Every target, perturbation, source, trial, endpoint value, and review identity in the conformance slice is synthetic.
This is not a real ClinicalTrials.gov extraction, an independently reviewed disease slice, clinical validation, or therapeutic evidence.

maturity_ledger.label: Biohub platform or data integration
maturity_ledger.claim: Joint scoping could select one immune-perturbation use case and define a payload-minimized integration boundary.
limitations: This repository has no Biohub-specific API, data, authorization, or endorsement.
The proposed use case requires scientific-owner and governance review before execution.

fit_matrix.biohub_priority: AI biomodels and virtual-cell-enabled disease understanding
fit_matrix.contribution: Preserve the identity, source, biological context, uncertainty, and downstream decision consequences of an upstream biomodel hypothesis.
fit_matrix.current_gap: A generic contextual handoff is implemented, but no approved biomodel fixture or virtual-cell integration exists.

fit_matrix.contribution: Test whether perturbation-to-program evidence packets expose missing context, conflicting evidence, and safer next experiments before translational escalation.
fit_matrix.current_gap: The generic perturbation contract is synthetic; no immune-program cohort or external scientific-owner workflow is present.

fit_matrix.biohub_priority: Molecular measurement of inflammation in human tissues
fit_matrix.contribution: Represent measurement provenance, tissue and cell context, endpoint mappings, and uncertainty as explicit decision dependencies.
fit_matrix.current_gap: The generic tissue/cell/assay context is implemented, but no platform-specific assay contract or reviewed fixture is mapped.

fit_matrix.contribution: Provide dependency-light typed contracts, deterministic validators, public schemas, synthetic fixtures, replay, and release-boundary audits.
fit_matrix.current_gap: The candidate research branch is not merged or uploaded, and external-user usability has not been measured.

pilot.research_question: Can a provenance-preserving handoff from immune-cell perturbation evidence to a bounded translational decision packet improve auditability, reviewer agreement, and evidence-gap resolution speed without silently promoting unsupported biological or clinical claims?
pilot.unit_of_analysis: One candidate-disease-context program packet with one declared perturbation context and a frozen evidence cutoff.
input_contract: perturbation identity, direction, modality, and intervention context
cell type, tissue, species, assay, and model-system identifiers
effect estimate, uncertainty, endpoint, comparator, and quality-control status
source locator, version, content hash, observed date, and available date
reviewer-authored interpretation and explicit unresolved limitations
output_contract: contextual evidence records that cannot alone satisfy efficacy or clinical gates
bounded next-action plan with cost and stop conditions
reviewer decision record and exact replay bundle
aggregate pilot evaluation without raw program payloads

work_packages.title: Upstream evidence handoff contract
work_packages.objective: Define and test the minimum context required to carry a cell-state or perturbation result into the evidence ledger as contextual evidence only.
deliverables: strict JSON Schema and duplicate-safe reader
mapping table from upstream fields to project identities and evidence records
explicit rejection rules for missing comparator, context, cutoff, or provenance

work_packages.title: Retrospective immune-perturbation packet cohort
work_packages.objective: Build 12 to 20 reviewer-selected packets and a frozen manual baseline without using downstream outcomes to choose the cohort.

work_packages.title: Prospective workflow evaluation
work_packages.objective: Compare manual and governed workflows on replay, provenance completeness, agreement, time, and silent-advance failures.
deliverables: aggregate metric report with exact denominators

work_packages.title: Governance and release boundary
work_packages.objective: Keep real program data, identities, reviewer materials, and unpublished results outside public release until separately approved.

phases.name: Scope and preregister
exit_criteria: Scientific owner approves the unit of analysis and non-claims.
Input contract and data boundary pass privacy and provenance review.
Pilot protocol is frozen before packet selection.

phases.name: Build contract and retrospective cohort
exit_criteria: At least 12 eligible packets pass the strict input contract.
All included packets have frozen source hashes and evidence cutoffs.
Adversarial schema and provenance tests pass.

phases.name: Run blinded workflow evaluation
exit_criteria: Manual and governed arms cover the exact same packet roster.
Reviewers complete decisions without access to aggregate outcomes.
Every decision has a replayable provenance record or an explicit failure status.

phases.name: Analyze, adjudicate, and decide
exit_criteria: All acceptance gates are evaluated on exact declared denominators.
Failures are adjudicated without changing thresholds or excluding failed packets post hoc.
Scientific, engineering, and governance owners issue a go, revise, or stop decision.

evaluation_design.comparator: Reviewer-authored manual packet workflow on the identical frozen program roster.
evaluation_design.primary_endpoint: Fraction of included program packets with exact end-to-end replay and complete source provenance.
secondary_endpoints: independent reviewer agreement on advance, hold, defer, pivot, or stop
median reviewer time per completed packet
count and type of silently promoted unsupported claims
fraction of evidence gaps linked to an actionable and budget-bounded next step
adjudication burden and unresolved packet fraction
evaluation_design.analysis_boundary: Workflow reliability and research usability only; no therapeutic efficacy, clinical utility, biomodel accuracy, or Biohub endorsement endpoint is evaluated.

acceptance_gates.metric: Fraction of included packets whose used evidence records have source id, version, content hash, and cutoff-safe availability date.
Fraction of completed governed-workflow packets that reproduce the accepted final state and decision from the frozen inputs.
Count of packets advanced after a required identity, provenance, context, mapping, or reviewer-approval gate failed.
Unweighted fraction of program packets with identical primary workflow decisions from two independent blinded reviewers before adjudication.
acceptance_gates.denominator: Packets completed independently by both reviewers.

acceptance_gates.metric: Relative reduction in median active reviewer minutes per completed packet versus the manual comparator.
acceptance_gates.denominator: Matched packets completed in both workflow arms.

governance.stopping_rule: Stop execution on any provenance, replay, privacy, authorization, or silent-advance hard-gate failure; do not repair the denominator by post-hoc exclusion.

presentation.audience: Biohub computational biology, platform engineering, translational science, and research-governance collaborators.
presentation.headline_claim: The project is a verification-oriented bridge from biological hypotheses to translational evidence decisions, not a replacement for virtual-cell science or expert judgment.

claims.text: The public core makes evidence, tools, identity, time, uncertainty, costs, and decisions replayable and fail-closed.
One retrospective SCD program demonstrates continuous identity and evidence flow across the eight-stage control plane.
Endpoint and safety evidence can be harmonized under explicit ratio-measure direction semantics without erasing trial-level values, source identity, reviewer mappings, or non-comparability limits.

A synthetic ulcerative-colitis slice shows that one immune-inflammatory disease identity can traverse contextual handoff, clinical-remission mapping, higher-is-better odds-ratio synthesis, and evidence-tensor compilation.
Synthetic known-truth studies expose when estimand, missingness, dependence, and cluster sampling choices alter uncertainty; they do not establish external clinical calibration.
The strongest Biohub-context fit is a complementary translational evidence-governance layer downstream of cell measurement, perturbation, and biomodel research.
A strict generic perturbation handoff preserves biological context, source lineage, effect uncertainty, sampling, quality control, and review boundaries while emitting contextual evidence only.
A 90-day immune-perturbation handoff evaluation is concrete enough for joint scoping but has not been executed or endorsed.

slide_sequence.title: Where scientific agents fail
slide_sequence.purpose: Frame the problem as evidence and decision continuity across a long research trajectory.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: Do not claim autonomous drug discovery.

slide_sequence.title: The system role
slide_sequence.purpose: Place the project downstream of cell and biomodel science and upstream of translational evidence decisions.

slide_sequence.title: Executable control plane
slide_sequence.purpose: Show typed state, tool contracts, evidence promotion, verifiers, decisions, and replay.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: Contract execution is not biological truth.

slide_sequence.title: One continuous disease slice
slide_sequence.purpose: Demonstrate what is end to end today and make the single-disease boundary visible.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: Seven proposed atlases do not have equivalent public slices.

slide_sequence.title: Endpoint and safety without provenance loss
slide_sequence.purpose: Show exact trial mappings, explicit effect direction, non-pooled synthesis, cross-disease conformance, and typed evidence gaps.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: The ulcerative-colitis artifact is synthetic contract conformance, not real clinical validation or a treatment recommendation.

slide_sequence.title: Uncertainty is part of the object
slide_sequence.purpose: Present the known-truth calibration sequence and the remaining dominant-cluster failure mode.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: Synthetic calibration is not external transportability.

slide_sequence.title: Biohub-context fit and gaps
slide_sequence.purpose: Separate direct, complementary, and proposed alignment using official public sources.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: No Biohub data or platform is currently integrated.

slide_sequence.title: A falsifiable 90-day pilot
slide_sequence.purpose: Define the unit, roster, phases, comparator, endpoints, and hard gates before execution.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: This is a proposed workflow study, not a completed collaboration.

slide_sequence.title: Machine-checkable claims
slide_sequence.purpose: Demonstrate schema, artifact hashes, maturity classes, and fail-closed validation.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: A green validator confirms declared evidence consistency, not scientific endorsement.

slide_sequence.title: The decision requested
slide_sequence.purpose: Ask whether to jointly scope the handoff contract and select a scientifically owned pilot cohort.
slide_sequence.speaker_boundary: Request a scoping decision, not approval to deploy.

prohibited_claims: autonomous therapeutic design or treatment recommendation
a real or independently reviewed ulcerative-colitis disease slice
external transportability of synthetic cluster templates
real-world clinical calibration or policy superiority

known_gaps.gap: The generic public handoff is synthetic and has not been reviewed against an external scientific-owner cell-state or perturbation fixture.
closure_evidence_required: scientific-owner mapping of assay and endpoint semantics

known_gaps.gap: No Biohub dataset, API, model output, platform workflow, or authorization is integrated.
closure_evidence_required: integration tests on approved non-sensitive fixtures

known_gaps.gap: Only sickle-cell disease has a continuous public eight-stage vertical slice; ulcerative colitis now adds real provider-level phase/population validation but not an independently reviewed end-to-end disease slice.
closure_evidence_required: at least one independently reviewed non-synthetic immune or inflammatory disease slice
real source bundles with scientific-owner mapping and review
cross-disease transport and endpoint-harmonization error analysis
documented ambiguity, direction-reversal, and rejection cases

known_gaps.gap: No real independently curated held-out Biohub-context outcome board is public or claimed.
Synthetic cluster templates and calibration results do not transport to an external program population by construction.
The 0.3.0.dev3 research candidate is not merged to public main or uploaded to the public Hugging Face dataset.
closure_evidence_required: commit-pinned GitHub and Hugging Face publication

decision.next_decision: Preregister an independent maintenance-trial replication, then nominate a second immune/inflammatory disease with explicit endpoint-family, population, estimand, and safety-window mappings.
